capabilities: plan recurring weekly routines on a 7-day board
add timed and untimed cards to weekdays
time-block daily schedules with draggable entries
import weekly routines into dated daily plans
store daily plans as Markdown notes
disambiguation: Not only a weekly overview; it also includes a dated daily time-blocking planner that imports the weekday routines.
extras: Includes migration instructions for users of the standalone Day Canvas plugin, which it now supersedes; existing plugin ID and weekly cards are retained.
motivation: To keep a clean visual reference of the regular week inside Obsidian instead of cluttering the one-off calendar with recurring items.
problem: Obsidian has no visual board for recurring weekly routines, so regular chores like laundry or gym end up cluttering one-off calendars and daily notes.

relations.evidence: Update Weekly Routine Board, then disable the standalone Day Canvas plugin.

summary: Weekly routine board that plans recurring tasks across all seven days, bundled with a dated Day Canvas daily planner for time blocking.
